# form.addSliderField

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.5.2</span></div>

Add a slider field to the current form.

```lua
form.addSliderField(line, rect, min, max, getValue, setValue)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `line` | FormLine | yes | the line where the field should be added |
| `rect` | Rect | yes | the coordinates |
| `min` | integer | yes | the min value |
| `max` | integer | yes | the max value |
| `getValue` | function | yes | the function which will return the current value |
| `setValue` | function | yes | the function which will be called on value change |

## Returns

The new field

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
form.addSliderField(line, nil, 0, 100, function() return value end, function(newValue) value = newValue end)
```
